headline: Nitto ATP Finals Semifinals: Alcaraz meets Shelton before Zverev takes on Medvedev in Turin
whyCareReason: Carlos Alcaraz battles Ben Shelton in the afternoon semifinal before World No. 1 Alexander Zverev faces Daniil Medvedev tonight for a place in Sunday's championship match.
teaser: The final four at the 2026 Nitto ATP Finals is set: Carlos Alcaraz takes on American powerhouse Ben Shelton at 14:00 CET, followed by Alexander Zverev facing familiar rival Daniil Medvedev at 20:30 CET at Inalpi Arena.
story:
The 2026 Nitto ATP Finals in Turin reached the semifinal stage on Saturday, 21 November, setting up two blockbuster clashes between the tournament's top-performing stars at Inalpi Arena.

In the afternoon semifinal at 2:00 p.m. CET, World No. 2 Carlos Alcaraz faces explosive third seed Ben Shelton. Alcaraz arrives with supreme confidence after sweeping the Ivan Lendl Group with an unblemished 3-0 record, having dropped only 16 total games across six sets. Shelton secured the runner-up spot in the John McEnroe Group with a clinical 6-3, 6-4 victory over Rafael Jodar on Thursday, relying on his booming left-handed serve to reach his maiden ATP Finals semifinal.

The evening semifinal at 8:30 p.m. CET features a heavyweight rivalry between World No. 1 Alexander Zverev and 2020 champion Daniil Medvedev. Zverev marched through the McEnroe Group with a flawless 3-0 record, culminating in a 6-4, 7-6 (5) victory over Arthur Fils. Medvedev earned his final four berth by defeating Frances Tiafoe 6-4, 6-4 on Friday. With a spot in Sunday's final on the line, both showdowns promise world-class indoor hard-court tennis.
stakes: The winners advance to Sunday's Nitto ATP Finals championship match, competing for 1,500 ranking points and the prestigious season-ending trophy.
rivalryAngle: Zverev and Medvedev contest their 21st career meeting at tour level, while Alcaraz and Shelton renew their rivalry following their thrilling US Open quarterfinal clash.
funFacts: Alexander Zverev has won 22 of his last 24 sets played indoors at the Inalpi Arena.
Carlos Alcaraz did not face a single break point across his last two group-stage victories in Turin.
Ben Shelton has fired 43 aces across his three group-stage matches, the most of any player in the tournament.
